articles.title: Trump Jr's firm leads $1 billion Polymarket raise at $21 billion value: Report
articles.snippet: 1789 Capital is putting in about $300 million, adding to a roughly $200 million stake, as the prediction market's valuation rises from $15 billion.

articles.title: North Korean hackers are moving tens of millions on Hyperliquid as Trump pushes to onshore the crypto platform
articles.snippet: Blockchain data reviewed by CoinDesk shows wallets tied to North Korea’s Lazarus Group sold more than $30 million in bitcoin on the platform in the last three weeks alone.

articles.title: Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital leads Polymarket’s $1B raise: Report
articles.snippet: Donald Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital will reportedly lead a $1 billion investment round into Polymarket, which would value the platform at $21 billion, just below Kalshi’s $22 billion valuation.

articles.title: Hyperliquid in Talks With Kraken Parent to Bring Crypto Perps to US Traders
articles.snippet: A deal would route the decentralized exchange's perpetual futures through Payward's US-regulated Bitnomial, marking Hyperliquid's first US entry—weeks after Trump said his administration was working to bring it onshore.

articles.title: Ex-White House Teleprompter Operator Fined for Prediction Market Insider Trading
articles.snippet: Gabriel Perez used his access to Trump's speeches before delivery to bet on "presidential mention market" contracts, profiting more than $107,500 before the CFTC caught up with him.
